deliverables: Design report with design basis, assumptions, results, and known limitations.
Operating philosophy and plans for the published scenarios.
Site layout, safety provisions, and maintenance access.
format: Choose clear file formats and project organization. State units and identify assumptions and calculations.
minimum_reconstruction_content: Equipment instances and catalog model IDs.
Physical process topology and boundary interfaces.
Pipeline paths, diameters, pipe classes, and installation levels.
Scenario-specific operating paths, flows, and setpoints.
Lifecycle-cost calculation basis, component breakdown, and result.

provenance.note: Deterministic development-case data; not vendor data or production engineering criteria.

purpose: Communicate a complete engineering design for the stated project requirements and operating scenarios.
reconstructability: Final artifacts must define the proposed physical system and every required operating scenario with enough precision for an independent reviewer to reconstruct and recalculate the design without relying on unstated assumptions.
